Welcome to this charming 2-bedroom apartment on the third floor, located in the heart of Reykjavik city center. Just steps away from main attractions, restaurants, shops, and iconic landmarks, it offers the perfect base for your stay.

Enjoy a relaxing retreat in a modern, stylish space equipped with excellent amenities for your comfort.

The space
🛏️ Sleeping arrangements – 2 Bedrooms

♛ Master Bedroom: Double Bed
♛ Bedroom 2: Two Double Beds
♛ Living Room: Sleeping sofa suitable for two people

All bedrooms feature : Premium Pillows, Linens, Sheets, Black-Out curtains, and Nightstands with Reading Lights. 

🛋️ Living Area 

- Comfortable sofa can be converted into a sleeping sofa with plenty of space for two people and comes with an extra pillows. 

🍽️ Kitchen & Dining Area 

- Stove
- Oven
- Toaster
- Refrigerator/Freezer
- Dishwasher
- Coffee Maker
- Hot Water Kettle
- Sink (Hot & Cold Water)
- Trays, Glasses, Silverware, Pots & Pans
- Dining table & chairs 

🚿 Bathroom
The bathroom is stocked with fresh towels and essential toiletries, so you can pack light and enjoy a worry-free stay.

- Walk-In Shower
- Vanity
- Mirror
- Toilet
- Towels
- Hair Dryer
- Essential Toiletries

👶 Baby Essentials (Upon Request)

⭐ Baby Crib – A safe, comfortable sleeping space for your little one.
⭐ High Chair – Makes mealtimes easy and mess-free.

We look forward to hosting you and hope you find your happiness in this fantastic apartment—whether that means unplugging for a while, watching a movie, curling up with a good book, or enjoying a relaxing drink on the balcony. 🌟

Guest access
The apartment is exclusively yours, without interruption for the duration of your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home. Other than the already mentioned amenities, our home also comes with:

🌐 High-Speed Wi-Fi
🗝️ Self Check-In
🔥 Heating
🧺 Washer
🪞 Iron/Board
🌿 Private Balcony
🍽️ Restaurants and shops nearby

Other things to note
🚭 NO SMOKING INSIDE ➞ Please refrain from smoking inside the home. Any evidence of smoking will result in additional fees for odor removal, duct cleaning, and furniture cleaning.

🎉NO PARTIES OR EVENTS  ➞ We kindly ask that you treat our home with care and respect to help maintain its pristine condition for future guests and your return visits. All noise-related complaints will be taken very seriously.

🕒 CHECK-IN & CHECK-OUT
Check-in: 3:00 PM & Check-out: 11:00 AM
